Container.Name: lossy-mirror
Container.Overview: Mirrors a music library, converting lossless audio (flac, wav, ape) to a compact format such as ogg vorbis. Everything else is copied, deletions follow the source, tags are preserved. Watches the source and sweeps periodically. Configured in /config/mirror.toml.

Config.Name: Mirror
Config.Description: Lossy mirror. Fully managed: files not derived from the source are deleted.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: mirror.toml (filter + conversions, default written on first start) and logs

Config.Name: Armed
Config.Description: 0 = plan only: one dry-run pass logged to /config/logs, nothing written. 1 = mirror.

Config.Name: Parallel jobs
Config.Description: Files processed in parallel, one ffmpeg each

Config.Name: Debounce seconds
Config.Description: Quiet time after the last source change before a pass starts

Config.Name: Sweep hours
Config.Description: Full pass interval, catches changes inotify missed

Config.Name: Max delete ratio
Config.Description: Skip orphan removal if it would delete more than this share of the mirror
